classification.difficultyReason: Solve each quadratic by three specified algebraic methods and reconcile the results.

content.prompt: In each case, find the zeroes of the quadratic function first by factoring, then by completing the square, and finally by using the quadratic formula. Observe that the answers to all three methods are the same for each function.

answer.worked:
Factoring:
$$\begin{align*}(x-4)(x+1)&=0\\x&=4\text{ or }-1\end{align*}$$
Completing the square:
$$\begin{align*}x^2-3x&=4\\\left(x-\frac32\right)^2&=\frac{25}4\\x&=\frac32\pm\frac52\\x&=4\text{ or }-1\end{align*}$$
Quadratic formula:
$$\begin{align*}\Delta&=(-3)^2-4(1)(-4)=25\\x&=\frac{3\pm\sqrt{25}}2\\x&=4\text{ or }-1\end{align*}$$
All three methods give the same zeroes.

Factoring:
$$\begin{align*}(x-2)(x-3)&=0\\x&=2\text{ or }3\end{align*}$$
Completing the square:
$$\begin{align*}x^2-5x&=-6\\\left(x-\frac52\right)^2&=\frac14\\x&=\frac52\pm\frac12\\x&=2\text{ or }3\end{align*}$$
Quadratic formula:
$$\begin{align*}\Delta&=(-5)^2-4(1)(6)=1\\x&=\frac{5\pm\sqrt1}2\\x&=2\text{ or }3\end{align*}$$
All three methods give the same zeroes.

Factoring:
$$\begin{align*}-(x-6)(x+2)&=0\\x&=6\text{ or }-2\end{align*}$$
Completing the square:
$$\begin{align*}x^2-4x&=12\\(x-2)^2&=16\\x&=2\pm4\\x&=6\text{ or }-2\end{align*}$$
Quadratic formula:
$$\begin{align*}\Delta&=4^2-4(-1)(12)=64\\x&=\frac{-4\pm\sqrt{64}}{-2}\\x&=-2\text{ or }6\end{align*}$$
All three methods give the same zeroes.
